steps.title: (OPTIONAL) If you want to listen …
steps.text: (OPTIONAL) If you want to listen to me ramble about the route for an hour listen to this video

steps.title: Sell all of your starting items …
steps.text: Sell all of your starting items to the general store except your Bread and Shrimps

steps.title: Speak to Count Check and have …
steps.text: Speak to Count Check and have him teleport you to the Stronghold of security

steps.title: Pick up some Cooked meat in …
steps.text: Pick up some Cooked meat in the longhouse to the north. — Hop worlds for more. 6 should be plenty but you could get more if you are scared

steps.title: Complete the first 3 levels of …
steps.text: Complete the first 3 levels of the Stronghold of security to get your free 10k gp

steps.title: Home teleport
steps.text: Home teleport

steps.title: Buy a bronze axe and a …
steps.text: Buy a bronze axe and a steel axe from Bob

steps.title: Drop any extra food
steps.text: Drop any extra food

steps.title: Buy a Spade and an empty …
steps.text: Buy a Spade and an empty jug from the general store

steps.title: Complete X Marks the Spot. — …
steps.text: Complete X Marks the Spot. — Fill the jug with water in the kitchen when you pass by. — Do not use the lamp, destroy it to be reclaimed later

steps.title: Get level 20 Agility at the …
steps.text: Get level 20 Agility at the Draynor Village Rooftop Course

steps.title: Purchase a Chronicle and 20 Teleport …
steps.text: Purchase a Chronicle and 20 Teleport cards

steps.title: Walk to Ardougne
steps.text: Walk to Ardougne

steps.title: complete Hazeel Cult. — Take the …
steps.text: complete Hazeel Cult. — Take the boat in Rimmington to get there. — Make sure to side with Hazeel

steps.title: Complete Monk's Friend. — Chop some …
steps.text: Complete Monk's Friend. — Chop some logs nearby. — Make sure to pop some balloons so you don't curse your accounts RNG

steps.title: Head to the general store in …
steps.text: Head to the general store in Port Khazard and purchase some Swamp paste and a tinderbox

steps.title: Chop
steps.text: Chop

steps.title: burn logs in the area until …
steps.text: burn logs in the area until you reach 30 Firemaking
steps.note: 1-tick make redwood/rosewood pyre logs (needs Shades of Mort'ton) for fastest XP; else burn coloured/firelighter logs.

steps.title: Complete Sea slug
steps.text: Complete Sea slug

steps.title: Drop all of your items except …
steps.text: Drop all of your items except your coins

steps.title: Get 25 Thieving at cake stalls. …
steps.text: Get 25 Thieving at cake stalls. — Complete Tribal Totem when you can

steps.title: Get an inventory of cakes
steps.text: Get an inventory of cakes

steps.title: head over to the Brimhaven Agility …
steps.text: head over to the Brimhaven Agility Arena

steps.title: Train there until level 50 Agility. …
steps.text: Train there until level 50 Agility. — Start by jumping over the Floor spikes (Brimhaven Agility Arena) until you can start collecting tickets consistently. You will need 30 agility to do most, and 40 agility to do all the obstacles.

steps.title: Chronicle teleport to Varrock
steps.text: Chronicle teleport to Varrock

steps.title: Complete Shield of Arrav. — Join …
steps.text: Complete Shield of Arrav. — Join the Phoenix Gang. — Buy a shortbow and some iron arrows from the Archery shop to kill Jonny the Beard to save melee xp. — If you have an alt, you can join the Black Arm gang and have them kill the Weaponsmaster for you. — This saves a lot of combat xp and is easy to do, so strongly consider it.

steps.title: Complete Children of the Sun
steps.text: Complete Children of the Sun

steps.title: Head to Varlamore
steps.text: Head to Varlamore

steps.title: complete Ethically Acquired Antiquities until you …
steps.text: complete Ethically Acquired Antiquities until you are in Port Sarim. — Use the Charter ship to get to Port Sarim

steps.title: Buy a Feather from Gerrant
steps.text: Buy a Feather from Gerrant

steps.title: Head over to Kourend and complete …
steps.text: Head over to Kourend and complete Client of Kourend. Veos might return your lamp from X marks the spot, destroy it again. — During this quest, steal from Fruit stalls until level 31 Thieving. — Save any Strange fruit you get for some free run restoration. — Use the Client of Kourend lamps on Hitpoints. DO NOT USE THE X MARKS THE SPOT LAMP. — During the quest, quickly change to the Arceuus spellbook and back so that you can make house portals with the teleports later.

steps.title: Continue, complete Ethically Acquired Antiquities
steps.text: Continue, complete Ethically Acquired Antiquities

steps.title: Head over to Aldarin in Varlamore
steps.text: Head over to Aldarin in Varlamore

steps.title: Complete Death on the Isle. — …
steps.text: Complete Death on the Isle. — Do not fight back during the first fight. It will be completed when you are almost dead. — Attacking with the Prop sword does not give xp

steps.title: Minigame teleport to Clan wars
steps.text: Minigame teleport to Clan wars

steps.title: Store any gp you have in …
steps.text: Store any gp you have in the coffer there

steps.title: Completely empty your inventory after that
steps.text: Completely empty your inventory after that

steps.title: Get 40 Prayer by picking up …
steps.text: Get 40 Prayer by picking up big bones at the Boneyard and using them on the Chaos Altar. — Don't go for Protection from melee at this time. — Do not kill anything for a Looting bag. You don't want to level up.
steps.note: Offer bones at a gilded altar in a POH with both incense burners lit (fastest); Chaos altar in the Wilderness is ~half the cost.

steps.title: Get an iron dagger(p) and a …
steps.text: Get an iron dagger(p) and a Lockpick from pickpocketing Rogues in the deep wilderness. — Get some cakes from Ardougne to use as food. Use the wilderness lever from Ardougne to complete the diary step. — When you are poisoning things in the next sections, be careful not to waste combat xp you don't need to. You should have enough on average, but if you waste xp then bad luck could force you to gain an extra level. — Seriously, I have had numerous people tell me they had to gain an extra level because they were careless with their xp. — Use the Poison plugin on Runelite to help track your attacks and timer.

steps.title: (Optional) If you have an alternate …
steps.text: (Optional) If you have an alternate account, you can use a venom alt to help out killing things and conserving combat xp. — Watch this video for a quick tutorial on how to do this. — Using Wind strike is often a good way to get the needed damage on your UIM in the short time window.

steps.title: Get you cash stack back out …
steps.text: Get you cash stack back out of the coffers at Clan Wars. Don't use your minigame teleport to get there

steps.title: Steal from Aldarin chests until level …
steps.text: Steal from Aldarin chests until level 50 Thieving. — Fishing Trawler minigame teleport, then take the charter ship to Aldarin. — You can drop the Lockpick after you are done. — Drop all of the loot other than coins.

steps.title: Once finished, Home Teleport
steps.text: Once finished, Home Teleport

steps.title: Speak to Duke Horacio in the …
steps.text: Speak to Duke Horacio in the castle to start Rune Mysteries

steps.title: Start The Restless Ghost
steps.text: Start The Restless Ghost

steps.title: complete it until you get the …
steps.text: complete it until you get the skull. — Get some Leather Gloves from the spawn by Father Urhney. DO NOT FORGET THIS

steps.title: Speak to Archmage Sedridor to continue …
steps.text: Speak to Archmage Sedridor to continue Rune Mysteries

steps.title: Head to Draynor Village
steps.text: Head to Draynor Village

steps.title: buy a Chronicle again. — It …
steps.text: buy a Chronicle again. — It should still have some charges, but buy more if you ever run out

steps.title: Chronicle Teleport and continue Rune Mysteries …
steps.text: Chronicle Teleport and continue Rune Mysteries by speaking to Aubury

steps.title: Chronicle Teleport, walk back to Lumbridge
steps.text: Chronicle Teleport, walk back to Lumbridge

steps.title: complete The Restless Ghost
steps.text: complete The Restless Ghost

steps.title: Claim a Training bow and Training …
steps.text: Claim a Training bow and Training arrows from the Ranged combat tutor

steps.title: Continue, complete Rune Mysteries
steps.text: Continue, complete Rune Mysteries

steps.title: Buy wine from Fortunato
steps.text: Buy wine from Fortunato

steps.title: head to the H.A.M. Hideout
steps.text: head to the H.A.M. Hideout

steps.title: Steal from H.A.M. Members until you …
steps.text: Steal from H.A.M. Members until you get a Rusty sword and an uncut opal. — There is technically a 1/96 chance your rusty sword won't work, so you could get 2

steps.title: Reclaim your lamp from X Marks …
steps.text: Reclaim your lamp from X Marks the Spot. Save it for now

steps.title: Head to Port Sarim and purchase …
steps.text: Head to Port Sarim and purchase some items from Wydin. — a few cheese — raw beef — raw chicken — A few other random items for food like cabbage and bananas. Wine lowers you combat stats so you don't want it for this.

steps.title: Safepot, kill a Giant rat nearby …
steps.text: Safepot, kill a Giant rat nearby with Ranged for the meat. — Drop the bow and arrows afterwards

steps.title: Take the boat to Ardougne
steps.text: Take the boat to Ardougne

steps.title: Head north to safe spot and …
steps.text: Head north to safe spot and poison a bear for some raw bear meat

steps.title: Take the boat back to Rimmington
steps.text: Take the boat back to Rimmington

steps.title: Collect some snape grass west of …
steps.text: Collect some snape grass west of the Crafting guild for later

steps.title: Complete Druidic Ritual
steps.text: Complete Druidic Ritual

steps.title: Complete Witch's House. — Safe spot …
steps.text: Complete Witch's House. — Safe spot the boss and kill it with poison. — If you don't know how to safe spot the first 2 phases watch the video. — Keep the first form in combat with you by occasionally tanking a hit, or it can despawn.

steps.title: (Optional) If you would like, you …
steps.text: (Optional) If you would like, you could accept more risk and start the Wilderness Agility section right now rather than continue to gain more Hitpoints levels. — This video talks about some pros and cons of doing this. — You will still need to come back and finish the remaining quests from this section later. — If you go this route, use the X Marks the Spot lamp on Hitpoints. — Also collect your 1k xp lamp from Historian Minas and use it on Hitpoints.

steps.title: Use the X Marks the Spot …
steps.text: Use the X Marks the Spot lamp on Herblore. — If you are coming back later after having used this lamp already, you can buy a Greenman's ale to boost to level 10 during the Dig Site.

steps.title: Use the Fishing Trawler minigame teleport
steps.text: Use the Fishing Trawler minigame teleport

steps.title: Head south into Yanille and view …
steps.text: Head south into Yanille and view Aleck's Hunter Emporium for the diary step

steps.title: Return north and have Tindel Marchant …
steps.text: Return north and have Tindel Marchant identify your rusty sword for the diary step

steps.title: Head out on a game of …
steps.text: Head out on a game of Fishing Trawler for the diary step. — You don't need to finish the game

steps.title: Head into Ardougne
steps.text: Head into Ardougne

steps.title: steal a silk. Hold on to …
steps.text: steal a silk. Hold on to it for later

steps.title: Have Wizard Cromperty teleport you to …
steps.text: Have Wizard Cromperty teleport you to the Rune essence mine for the diary step

steps.title: Check what pets you have insured …
steps.text: Check what pets you have insured with Probita for the diary step

steps.title: Use some prayer and restore your …
steps.text: Use some prayer and restore your prayer points at the Ardougne church for the diary step

steps.title: Buy a rope from the general …
steps.text: Buy a rope from the general store

steps.title: Head to the Gnome Stronghold and …
steps.text: Head to the Gnome Stronghold and into the Grand Tree

steps.title: Buy some items from Hudo for …
steps.text: Buy some items from Hudo for Plague City quest. — Dwellberries — Chocolate dust — Bucket of milk

steps.title: Return to Ardougne
steps.text: Return to Ardougne

steps.title: complete Plague City. — There is …
steps.text: complete Plague City. — There is a bucket spawn near the start of the quest

steps.title: Sell your silk to the Silk …
steps.text: Sell your silk to the Silk trader for 60 coins for the diary step

steps.title: Steal some cakes
steps.text: Steal some cakes

steps.title: Complete Biohazard. — You will need …
steps.text: Complete Biohazard. — You will need to poison the Mourner. — Keep him in combat by tanking hits as he can despawn. — Don't forget your Fishing Trawler minigame teleport to get back to the area.

steps.title: Enter the Combat Training Camp for …
steps.text: Enter the Combat Training Camp for the final step of the Ardougne Easy Diary. — Do not collect the rewards at this time

steps.title: Head to Karamja
steps.text: Head to Karamja

steps.title: complete Jungle Potion
steps.text: complete Jungle Potion

steps.title: Purchase the needed items for The …
steps.text: Purchase the needed items for The Dig Site in the Karamja General Store, Get the tea during the quest from the tea stall in east Varrock

steps.title: Complete The Dig Site
steps.text: Complete The Dig Site

steps.title: Complete Merlin's Crystal. — Make sure …
steps.text: Complete Merlin's Crystal. — Make sure you still have some combat xp available to kill 2 enemies with poison. — If you don't, you can clean more finds to make this up. — If you have an alt you can use it to help with Sir Mordred: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DvnhLKAi5xI

steps.title: Claim your xp lamps from Historian …
steps.text: Claim your xp lamps from Historian Minas

steps.title: use them on Hitpoints
steps.text: use them on Hitpoints

steps.title: Clean finds in the Varrock Museum …
steps.text: Clean finds in the Varrock Museum for Antique lamp (Varrock Museum) until you reach 30 Hitpoints so you can use the diary lamps, plus 1 additional lamp. — This will be 6 lamps total if I have done my math right and takes about 1.5-2 hours depending on RNG and effort. — Remember this lamping is optional if you just don't want to do it. It is just there to give you more HP at the course. — If you are on the fence, you can always just try it at lower hp and see how goes, then decide if you want to come back or not.
steps.note: HP trains passively from combat (1 damage = 1.33 HP XP) - any fast melee/ranged/magic method (crabs, NMZ, Slayer) levels it.

steps.title: Fishing Trawler minigame teleport and collect …
steps.text: Fishing Trawler minigame teleport and collect your rewards from the Ardougne Easy Diary. — Use the lamp on Hitpoints to reach 32 Hitpoints. If you are short a bit, just go back and clean finds for 1 more lamp.
steps.note: HP trains passively from combat (1 damage = 1.33 HP XP) - any fast melee/ranged/magic method (crabs, NMZ, Slayer) levels it.

steps.title: Start Dragon Slayer I so you …
steps.text: Start Dragon Slayer I so you can get an Anti-dragon shield

steps.title: This is the default tank build …
steps.text: This is the default tank build setup with 32 Hitpoints, 40 Prayer and 13 combat. — The next section will discuss some other optional builds you could go for
